questions.prompt: Do you like modern art or traditional art?

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Art Preferences
idioms: beauty is in the eye of the beholder

questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I think I like traditional art. It's more easy to understand. Modern art, I mean, is hard to figure out. I see old paintings in museums. Yeah, I like them.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, honestly, I'm more into traditional art. I find modern art a bit... difficult. It's not always clear what the artist is trying to say. With traditional art, you can usually appreciate the skill and the beauty more easily, you know? So, yeah, traditional for me.
questions.sampleBand7: I'd say I lean more towards traditional art, although I do appreciate some modern pieces. Traditional art, particularly paintings, often showcases incredible skill and detail. Modern art, while sometimes thought-provoking, can be a bit too abstract for my taste. It's not always accessible, and I prefer art that I can connect with more readily.
questions.sampleBand8: That's an interesting question. I think I have a slight preference for traditional art, but it really depends. I appreciate the technical skill and historical context that traditional art often embodies. Modern art, on the other hand, can be quite challenging, and sometimes I find it a bit pretentious. However, when modern art is done well, it can be incredibly thought-provoking and push the boundaries of what art can be. So, it's a mixed bag, really, but overall, I'd say traditional art edges it.
questions.sampleBand9: That's a great question. I'd probably say I gravitate more towards traditional art, although I certainly don't dismiss modern art outright. I think traditional art often demonstrates a mastery of technique and a deep understanding of form that I find incredibly compelling. You can really appreciate the craftsmanship. Modern art, while often conceptually interesting, can sometimes feel a bit inaccessible or even deliberately obscure. At the end of the day, I think I prefer art that speaks to me on an emotional level, and I often find that connection more easily with traditional works. There's no accounting for taste, of course, but that's my general feeling. To be honest, it comes down to personal preference.
questions.sampleAnswer: I tend to appreciate both, but for different reasons. Traditional art appeals to me because of its technical mastery and historical significance—works by Renaissance masters like Leonardo da Vinci demonstrate incredible skill and attention to detail. However, I also find modern art fascinating because it challenges conventional ideas and encourages viewers to think differently. Abstract and contemporary pieces often provoke thought and emotion in unexpected ways. If I had to choose, I'd say I lean slightly towards traditional art because I admire the craftsmanship, but I believe both forms have their unique value and place in the art world.

U har doim ham oson tushunarli emas va men ko'proq bog'lana oladigan san'atni afzal ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Bu qiziqarli savol. Menimcha, an'anaviy san'atga biroz ko'proq moyilman, lekin bu haqiqatan ham bog'liq. Men an'anaviy san'at ko'pincha o'zida mujassam etgan texnik mahorat va tarixiy kontekstni qadrlayman. Boshqa tomondan, zamonaviy san'at juda qiyin bo'lishi mumkin va ba'zan uni biroz dabdabali deb bilaman. Biroq, zamonaviy san'at yaxshi bajarilganda, u juda fikr uyg'otuvchi bo'lishi va san'at nima bo'lishi mumkinligining chegaralarini kengaytirishi mumkin. Shunday qilib, bu aralashma, aslida, lekin umuman olganda, men an'anaviy san'at ustunlik qiladi derdim.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Bu ajoyib savol. Men ehtimol an'anaviy san'atga ko'proq moyil bo'lardim, garchi zamonaviy san'atni butunlay rad etmasam ham. Menimcha, an'anaviy san'at ko'pincha texnikaning ustalik darajasini va shaklni chuqur tushunishni namoyish etadi, bu menga juda yoqadi. Siz haqiqatan ham hunarmandchilikni qadrlashingiz mumkin. Zamonaviy san'at, ko'pincha konseptual jihatdan qiziqarli bo'lsa-da, ba'zan biroz tushunarsiz yoki hatto ataylab yashirin bo'lib tuyulishi mumkin. Oxir oqibat, menimcha, menga hissiy darajada ta'sir qiladigan san'atni afzal ko'raman va men ko'pincha bu bog'liqlikni an'anaviy asarlar bilan osonroq topaman. Did borasida bahslashib bo'lmaydi, albatta, lekin bu mening umumiy tuyg'ularim. Rostini aytsam, bu shaxsiy afzallikka bog'liq.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Men ikkalasini ham qadrlashga moyilman, lekin har xil sabablarga ko'ra. An'anaviy san'at menga o'zining texnik mahorati va tarixiy ahamiyati bilan yoqadi - Leonardo da Vinchi kabi Uyg'onish davri ustalarining asarlari aql bovar qilmaydigan mahorat va tafsilotlarga e'tibor berishni namoyish etadi. Biroq, men zamonaviy san'atni ham qiziqarli deb bilaman, chunki u an'anaviy g'oyalarga qarshi chiqadi va tomoshabinlarni boshqacha fikrlashga undaydi. Abstrak va zamonaviy asarlar ko'pincha kutilmagan tarzda fikr va hissiyotlarni uyg'otadi. Agar tanlashim kerak bo'lsa, men an'anaviy san'atga biroz ko'proq moyil bo'lardim, chunki men hunarmandchilikka qoyil qolaman, lekin menimcha, ikkala shakl ham san'at olamida o'ziga xos qadriyat va o'ringa ega.

questions.prompt: Do you think it would be interesting for you to be an artist?
questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I don't think so. I'm not very good at art. I can't draw very well. I prefer to, um, look at art in a museum. Yes, it's better for me. I have no talent.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, probably not, actually. I mean, I appreciate art, but I'm not sure I have the patience to be an artist myself. I think it would be quite difficult to come up with original ideas all the time. And, um, I'm not very good at drawing or painting, so, yeah, probably not.
questions.sampleBand7: Well, that's an interesting question. I think it could be, but I'm not sure I have the right personality for it. I definitely admire artists, and I enjoy visiting art galleries. However, I'm not sure I'm creative enough to come up with original pieces. Plus, it seems like a tough career to make a living from.
questions.sampleBand8: Hmm, that's a good question. I think in some ways it would be fascinating. The idea of expressing myself creatively and bringing to life my own visions is certainly appealing. However, I also know that being a successful artist requires a lot of dedication and, let's face it, talent, which I'm not entirely sure I possess. I think I'd probably enjoy it as a hobby more than a profession. It's a case of knowing your limits, I guess.
questions.sampleBand9: That's a compelling thought. Honestly, the romanticism of being an artist – the freedom of expression, the ability to capture emotions on canvas – is incredibly appealing. However, I think the reality might be quite different. It's a highly competitive field, and success often depends as much on marketing and networking as it does on actual artistic skill. While I appreciate art and enjoy engaging with it, I suspect I'm better suited to being an appreciator than a creator. I feel I lack the drive and inherent skill to truly make a mark in that world, and it would be a constant struggle. In all honesty, I'd be a starving artist.
questions.sampleAnswer: While I find the idea appealing in some ways, I don't think I have the temperament or talent to be a professional artist. Being an artist requires not only technical skills but also creativity, patience, and the ability to handle criticism and financial uncertainty. I admire artists for their dedication and vision, but I prefer to appreciate art rather than create it. That said, I do enjoy creative hobbies like photography and sketching as a form of relaxation, but I wouldn't want the pressure of making it my career. I think being an artist is a calling that requires a special combination of passion and perseverance.

questions.uzSampleBand8: Hmm, bu yaxshi savol. Menimcha, ba'zi jihatlardan bu hayratlanarli bo'lardi. O'zimni ijodiy ifoda etish va o'z qarashlarimni hayotga olib kirish g'oyasi albatta jozibali. Biroq, men shuni ham bilamanki, muvaffaqiyatli rassom bo'lish katta sadoqatni va, ochig'ini aytsak, iste'dodni talab qiladi, bunga men to'liq ishonchim komil emas. Menimcha, bundan kasb sifatida ko'ra, hobbi sifatida ko'proq zavqlanardim. Bu o'z chegarangni bilish masalasi, deb o'ylayman.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Bu jozibali fikr. Rostini aytsam, rassom bo'lish romantikasi – ifoda erkinligi, tuvalda hissiyotlarni aks ettirish qobiliyati – juda jozibali. Biroq, menimcha, haqiqat butunlay boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin. Bu juda raqobatbardosh soha va muvaffaqiyat ko'pincha haqiqiy badiiy mahoratga qaraganda marketing va aloqalarga bog'liq. questions.uzSampleAnswer: Garchi bu fikr menga ba'zi jihatlardan yoqsa-da, men professional rassom bo'lish uchun temperamentim yoki qobiliyatim bor deb o'ylamayman. Men rassomlarni sadoqati va qarashlari uchun hurmat qilaman, lekin san'atni yaratishdan ko'ra, uni qadrlashni afzal ko'raman. questions.sampleBand6: Yes, I have. I went to an art gallery a while ago with my school. It was a pretty big one, I think it was the city's main gallery. Um, I remember mostly paintings. I didn't get into it that much, honestly, but it was okay.
questions.sampleBand7: Yes, I have visited an art gallery. I went to one last year in London, the Tate Modern. It was really impressive, a wide range of modern art, some of which I didn't really understand, to be honest. But it was still a good experience. I especially liked the abstract paintings and took some pictures.
questions.sampleBand8: Yes, I have. I recall visiting the National Gallery in Washington D.C. a few years back. It was absolutely amazing. They had a fantastic collection, spanning different periods and styles. I was particularly impressed by the Impressionist wing; I could have spent hours there just soaking up the atmosphere. It definitely broadened my horizons regarding art.
questions.sampleBand9: Yes, absolutely. I've visited several art galleries, and I find them incredibly stimulating. One that springs to mind is the Uffizi Gallery in Florence. The sheer concentration of masterpieces there is just breathtaking; Botticelli's "Birth of Venus" is particularly unforgettable. I think experiencing art firsthand, in the flesh, so to speak, offers a completely different perspective compared to just seeing reproductions in books. It really leaves a lasting impression and makes you appreciate the artist's skill and vision on a deeper level. It's definitely something I want to do more of.
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I've visited several art galleries over the years. The most memorable was the National Gallery when I traveled to London a few years ago. I was particularly impressed by the collection of Impressionist paintings—seeing works by Monet and Van Gogh in person was quite moving. The scale and detail of the paintings are something you can't fully appreciate through photographs or reproductions. I also enjoy visiting local galleries in my city, which often feature contemporary artists and rotating exhibitions. These visits give me a chance to disconnect from technology and engage with art in a more contemplative way.

questions.uzSampleBand9: Ha, albatta. Men bir nechta san'at galereyalariga tashrif buyurganman va ularni juda rag'batlantiruvchi deb bilaman. Esga tushadiganlardan biri Florensiyadagi Uffizi galereyasi. U yerdagi durdonalarning shunchaki konsentratsiyasi hayratlanarli; Botticellining "Veneraning tug'ilishi" ayniqsa unutilmas. questions.uzSampleAnswer: Ha, men yillar davomida bir nechta san'at galereyalarida bo'lganman. Eng yodda qolarlisi, bir necha yil oldin Londonga sayohat qilganimda Milliy galereya edi. questions.prompt: What do you do if your item is heavy?
questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, if it's really heavy, I try to, like, pick it up carefully. If I can't, I ask someone for help. Or maybe leave it there.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, if I find something is too heavy for me to carry, I will probably ask someone nearby to give me a hand. I mean, it depends on where I am, but that's usually what I do. Honestly, I don't want to hurt myself.
questions.sampleBand7: If I have to carry something heavy, the first thing I do is assess whether I can actually manage it safely. If it's clearly beyond my capabilities, I'll definitely ask for help. Or, perhaps, I'd try to find a trolley or something to move it.
questions.sampleBand8: Well, that depends on how heavy it is, doesn't it? If it's something I can just about manage, I'll try to lift it carefully, making sure to bend my knees. But if it's clearly too much, I'll either ask someone for assistance – perhaps a neighbour or a passer-by – or I might try to find some kind of mechanical aid, like a wheelbarrow, to move it around.
questions.sampleBand9: Oh, if I encounter a particularly heavy item, my immediate reaction is to assess the situation carefully. I wouldn't want to bite off more than I can chew, so to speak. If it's something I can realistically handle with proper technique, I'll proceed cautiously, employing ergonomic lifting methods. However, if it's patently beyond my strength, I'd seek out assistance without hesitation. Alternatively, I might explore the possibility of breaking it down into smaller, more manageable components, or consider using a suitable piece of equipment like a hand truck if available. Safety first, always!
questions.sampleAnswer: When I need to carry something heavy, I try to be practical and strategic about it. First, I assess whether I can break it down into smaller, more manageable pieces or make multiple trips rather than straining myself. If that's not possible, I'll use tools like a trolley or wheeled bag to reduce the physical burden. I'm also not too proud to ask for help when needed—whether from family, friends, or even store staff. I've learned from experience that trying to carry everything at once can lead to injury or dropping items, so it's better to be patient and methodical.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, agar u juda og'ir bo'lsa, men uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'tarishga harakat qilaman. Agar ilojim bo'lmasa, kimdandir yordam so'rayman. Yoki u yerda qoldiraman.
questions.uzSampleBand6: Agar men uchun juda og'ir narsa bo'lsa, men yaqin atrofdagi odamdan yordam so'rayman. Men qayerda ekanligimga bog'liq, lekin odatda shunday qilaman. Rostini aytsam, men o'zimga zarar yetkazmoqchi emasman.

questions.uzSampleBand8: Xo'sh, bu uning qanchalik og'irligiga bog'liq, to'g'rimi? Agar men zo'rg'a boshqara oladigan narsa bo'lsa, tizzalarimni bukib, uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'tarishga harakat qilaman. Ammo agar u aniq juda ko'p bo'lsa, men yoki kimdandir yordam so'rayman - balki qo'shnidan yoki o'tib ketayotgan odamdan - yoki uni ko'chirish uchun тачка kabi biror mexanik yordam topishga harakat qilishim mumkin.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Oh, agar men juda og'ir narsaga duch kelsam, mening birinchi reaksiyam vaziyatni diqqat bilan baholash bo'ladi. Men, ta'bir joiz bo'lsa, qo'limdan keladiganidan ortiqni olishni xohlamayman. Agar bu to'g'ri texnika bilan haqiqatan ham uddalay oladigan narsa bo'lsa, men ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilaman va ergonomik ko'tarish usullaridan foydalanaman. questions.uzSampleAnswer: Og'ir narsani ko'tarishim kerak bo'lsa, amaliy va strategik bo'lishga harakat qilaman. Avvalo, o'zimni zo'riqtirmaslik uchun uni mayda, boshqarish osonroq bo'laklarga ajratishim yoki bir necha marta borib kelishim mumkinmi, shuni baholayman. Agar bu iloji bo'lmasa, jismoniy yukni kamaytirish uchun trolley yoki g'ildirakli sumka kabi vositalardan foydalanaman. Shuningdek, kerak bo'lganda yordam so'rashdan uyalmayman - oilam, do'stlarim yoki hatto do'kon xodimlaridan. questions.sampleBand6: Um, yeah, I think so. When I go to work, I have to carry my laptop and some documents, you know, work stuff. But if I'm just going out with friends, I usually just bring my phone and wallet. It depends on the occasion, really.

For example, if I'm heading to the gym, I'll obviously take my gym bag with my workout clothes and a water bottle. But if I'm just going to the store, I'll grab my purse and maybe a reusable shopping bag. I try to cut down on plastic, you know?

However, if I'm simply running errands or going for a leisurely stroll in the park, I'll travel light with just my phone, a compact wallet, and perhaps a reusable water bottle. questions.sampleAnswer: Absolutely, what I carry varies significantly depending on where I'm going and what I'll be doing. For work, I typically bring my laptop, documents, and professional essentials in a briefcase or backpack. When I'm going to the gym, I pack workout clothes, a water bottle, and toiletries. For casual outings or shopping, I might just carry a small bag with my wallet, phone, and keys. I've learned to be selective about what I bring because carrying unnecessary items can be burdensome. I also try to plan ahead—for instance, if I know I'll be out all day, I'll pack snacks, a charger, and perhaps a book or headphones.

I'd like to talk about my best friend, Marcus, who has been an integral part of my life for over fifteen years. We first met in secondary school when we were both thirteen years old and were assigned to the same class.

Our friendship began quite naturally. We discovered we shared similar interests in music and sports, particularly basketball. Over the years, we've done so many things together. During our school days, we studied together, played sports, and went to concerts. As we got older, we traveled together—we backpacked through Southeast Asia after university, which was an incredible adventure that tested and strengthened our friendship. We've also supported each other through difficult times, like when I lost my grandfather and when Marcus went through a challenging breakup. Even now, despite our busy adult lives, we make time to meet regularly, whether it's for a casual coffee, a basketball game, or just a phone call to catch up.

Marcus is important to me for numerous reasons. Firstly, he knows me better than almost anyone else—he's seen me at my best and worst and has never judged me. He's incredibly loyal and trustworthy; I know I can confide in him about anything and it will remain between us. He's also been a positive influence on my life, encouraging me to pursue my goals and challenging me to be a better person. What I value most is his honesty—he's not afraid to tell me when I'm wrong or when I need to reconsider my decisions, which is rare in friendships.

Beyond the practical support, Marcus brings joy and laughter into my life. He has a great sense of humor and can always lighten my mood when I'm stressed. Our friendship has evolved from childhood playmates to adult confidants, and I genuinely believe he'll be in my life forever. Having someone who has known you for so long and still chooses to be your friend is truly special.

This combination helps them develop both depth and breadth in their social skills. The close friendships provide security and intimacy, while casual friendships teach them to interact with diverse personalities and navigate different social situations.

Through friendships, children learn to navigate peer relationships, practice social skills like negotiation and compromise, and develop their identity separate from their family. Friends also provide a different type of support—they're experiencing similar life stages and challenges, which creates a shared understanding that parents may not fully grasp. Additionally, friendships allow children to express themselves in ways they might not feel comfortable doing with family members. While family is irreplaceable in its own right, healthy friendships are essential for well-rounded social and emotional development.

questions.sampleAnswer: This is a complex question with no simple answer. There's also the risk of perceived favoritism, which can damage team morale and create resentment among other employees. However, I don't think managers need to be cold or distant. They can be friendly, approachable, and supportive without crossing into personal friendship territory. Some workplaces with flat hierarchies and collaborative cultures may make such friendships more feasible, but in traditional corporate structures, it's generally wiser to maintain professional relationships during work hours while perhaps developing friendships after one party has left the organization.

questions.sampleBand9: Children typically forge friendships at school through a multifaceted process. Firstly, the structured environment encourages interaction, whether it's through collaborative learning or extracurricular activities. Shared experiences, such as struggling with a difficult assignment or celebrating a team victory, can cement bonds. Beyond that, children are often drawn to those who share similar interests or personalities. The playground, in particular, serves as a microcosm of society where they learn the ropes of social interaction and navigate the complexities of friendship. And, of course, a child's inherent personality, whether outgoing or reserved, plays a significant role.
questions.sampleAnswer: Children typically form friendships at school through a combination of proximity, shared activities, and common interests. In younger grades, friendships often develop simply because children sit near each other or are placed in the same group for activities—physical proximity naturally leads to interaction and familiarity. As children grow older, shared interests become more important. They bond over common hobbies, sports teams, or academic subjects. Extracurricular activities like music, drama, or sports clubs provide excellent opportunities for friendship formation because they bring together children with similar passions. Personality compatibility also plays a role—children gravitate towards peers with similar temperaments or complementary characteristics. The school environment facilitates these connections through structured social interactions like group projects, lunch breaks, and recess. Teachers can also influence friendship formation by thoughtfully organizing seating arrangements and group activities. In modern times, social media and online gaming have added another dimension, allowing school friendships to extend beyond school hours.

questions.prompt: What are the differences between friends made inside and outside the workplace?

Outside of work, friendships are usually based on shared interests or history, and are, perhaps, more personal. Also, you choose them more freely.
questions.sampleBand8: Well, certainly, there are distinct differences. Friendships forged in the workplace often revolve around shared professional experiences and challenges. You build rapport through teamwork and navigating the work environment together. Friendships outside work, on the other hand, tend to be based on deeper, more personal connections, such as shared values, hobbies, or life experiences. Consequently, they can feel more authentic and less transactional.
questions.sampleBand9: The nature of the connection, I believe, is fundamentally different. Workplace friendships are often built on professional proximity and shared objectives; you're in the same boat, so to speak. While genuine bonds can certainly form, they're often influenced by workplace dynamics and hierarchies. Conversely, friendships outside of work are usually predicated on genuine shared interests and mutual respect, thereby fostering deeper, more meaningful connections. Moreover, the absence of professional pressures allows for a more relaxed and authentic dynamic, opening up more opportunities for vulnerability and personal growth. In the long run, these external friendships tend to be more resilient.
questions.sampleAnswer: Workplace friendships and outside friendships have distinct characteristics that stem from their different contexts. Workplace friends are often brought together by circumstance rather than pure choice—you're placed in proximity with colleagues and naturally develop relationships through daily interaction and shared professional experiences. These friendships can be quite strong, as you spend significant time together and face common challenges. However, they're sometimes constrained by professional boundaries and may be influenced by office politics or competition. There's also the risk that workplace friendships might not survive if one person leaves the company or if professional conflicts arise. In contrast, friendships formed outside work are typically based more purely on personal compatibility and shared interests unrelated to career. They're free from professional complications and power dynamics, allowing for more authentic self-expression. Outside friendships also tend to provide better work-life balance, as they offer an escape from work-related stress and conversations. That said, some of the strongest friendships can develop at work when colleagues discover genuine personal connections beyond their professional roles.

questions.sampleAnswer: This is a nuanced question that depends on various factors. Online friendships can certainly be valuable and meaningful—they allow people to connect across geographical boundaries and find others who share niche interests or experiences that might be rare in their local community. For people in isolated areas or with specific challenges, online friendships can provide crucial support and companionship. The depth of emotional connection in online friendships can be genuine, as people sometimes feel more comfortable opening up through text than in person. However, face-to-face friendships offer elements that online relationships struggle to replicate—physical presence, non-verbal communication, and shared real-world experiences create a different quality of connection. In-person friendships also tend to be more reliable in crisis situations, as friends can provide practical, immediate support. I think the ideal is a combination—online friendships can be valuable supplements to face-to-face relationships, and some online friendships can transition into real-world connections. The value ultimately depends on the depth of the connection, the effort both parties invest, and how the friendship meets each person's social and emotional needs.

questions.uzSampleAnswer: Bu turli omillarga bog'liq bo'lgan nozik savol. Onlayn do'stliklar, albatta, qimmatli va mazmunli bo'lishi mumkin—ular odamlarga geografik chegaralarni kesib o'tishga va o'z mahalliy jamiyatida kam uchraydigan tor qiziqishlar yoki tajribalarni baham ko'radigan boshqalarni topishga imkon beradi. Ajratilgan hududlarda yoki muayyan qiyinchiliklarga duch kelgan odamlar uchun onlayn do'stliklar muhim yordam va hamrohlikni ta'minlashi mumkin. Onlayn do'stliklardagi hissiy bog'liqlik chuqurligi chinakam bo'lishi mumkin, chunki odamlar ba'zan matn orqali shaxsan ko'ra ko'proq ochiq bo'lishadi. Biroq, yuzma-yuz do'stliklar onlayn munosabatlar nusxa ko'chirishga qiynaladigan elementlarni taklif qiladi - jismoniy hozirlik, og'zaki bo'lmagan muloqot va umumiy haqiqiy dunyo tajribalari bog'liqlikning boshqa sifatini yaratadi. Shaxsiy do'stliklar ham inqiroz vaziyatlarida ishonchliroq bo'lishga moyil, chunki do'stlar amaliy, tezkor yordam ko'rsatishi mumkin. Menimcha, ideal kombinatsiya—onlayn do'stliklar yuzma-yuz munosabatlarga qimmatli qo'shimchalar bo'lishi mumkin va ba'zi onlayn do'stliklar haqiqiy dunyo aloqalariga o'tishi mumkin. Qiymat oxir-oqibat bog'lanish chuqurligiga, har ikki tomonning sarmoyasiga va do'stlik har bir insonning ijtimoiy va hissiy ehtiyojlarini qanday qondirishiga bog'liq.
